target.statement: BalLOT achieves one-step recovery (exact recovery of planted clusters) on synthetic data from the balanced stochastic ball model with k=2 and separation Δ > 2√2, using diameter initialization.
target.dataset: Synthetic balanced stochastic ball model (k=2, d=2, n=1000, Δ=3)

compute.basis: Synthetic data generation and a few iterations of a small LP (n=1000, k=2) using scipy.optimize.linprog or POT; no training, no GPU, runs in seconds per trial.

blockers: No code released; must implement BalLOT (alternating LP and centroid update) from scratch
Requires an LP solver for the transportation problem (e.g., scipy or POT), but this is standard
title: BalLOT: Balanced $k$-means clustering with optimal transport
